name: Skyblock QoL: Mining & Dungeons
description: Unofficial Minecraft 1.21 Fabric port focused on Mining and Dungeon features. Includes a dedicated in-game settings GUI, Mining trackers and filters, Fetchur, HOTM tooltip, Commission Highlight, Pickobulus Preview, Ghost Tracker, Dungeon timers and split tracking, boss/Blood highlights, cached Dungeon data, and an adjustable Dungeon map.
